summary: This bill directs the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) to establish a global ocean monitoring and observing research program to collect and use ocean environmental data to improve scientific understanding and advance capabilities for climate, weather, and ocean needs.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a NOAA research program for global ocean monitoring and observing. Its purpose includes improving scientific understanding for climate, weather, and ocean needs, and undertaking interdisciplinary earth-system research on ocean heat content, Arctic ocean changes, and ocean carbon and biogeochemistry. This directly supports environmental protection through enhanced data collection and understanding of climate-related ocean processes.
